name: TravelPlanner
description: A benchmark testing complex real-world multi-constraint planning using a sandbox environment with approximately 4 million data entries across flights, hotels, restaurants, and attractions. Contains 1,225 curated travel planning intents with hard constraints (budget, time, preferences) across 6 planning tools. GPT-4 achieves only 0.6% final pass rate — one of the most cited agent failure statistics.
evaluation_method: final pass rate (% plans satisfying all hard and commonsense constraints)
general_score_metric: final pass rate (% plans satisfying all constraints)
typical_sota_score: ~5–15% final pass rate (frontier models as of 2025; GPT-4 was 0.6% at launch)
reputation: ICML 2024 Spotlight; GPT-4's 0.6% pass rate is one of the most cited agent failure statistics; widely cited in agent planning literature; active GitHub leaderboard
notes: ICML 2024 Spotlight. GPT-4's 0.6% final pass rate shocked the research community and is one of the most cited statistics in agent limitations literature. Three difficulty levels: easy (domestic, 3 days), medium (domestic, 5 days), hard (multi-city, 7 days). 6 planning tools: FlightSearch, AttractionSearch, AccommodationSearch, RestaurantSearch, NotebookTool, Planner. 4 million real travel data entries from genuine platforms.
